pcb_action: 改板：RCL 下端接 -18V/N18；若已接 GND，割线飞线到 N18；预留 0Ω 选择位。

evidence: r1 DC Iport: RCL-only=-41.99mA, VOS trim=-16.84mA, trim+servo=-3.64mA; AC Reff remains 1.054Ω.
pcb_action: 预留 current-sense summing node 的 DAC/电位器注入电阻位，建议 100k–1M；加 VSENSE/VSENSE_TRIM/ISIG 测试点。
caveat: 对高阻区需调度淡出，不能全范围固定同一补偿。

item: Slow DC servo to AD633 Z node
pcb_action: 预留慢速积分器或外接小板：IPORT_DC RC、低失调运放、ZSERVO 注入电阻、reset/disable、限幅。
caveat: 能显著降 r1 DC 偏置，但未把全范围压到 <1mA；若严苛目标需 AD633 feedthrough trim 或闭环阻抗伺服。

status: DIRECTION PASS / final value not frozen
evidence: 100p/220p baseline electrical dynamic pass=1/20; 10p/22p fast-comp pass=6/20. Median rel err dropped on many low/mid cases; high-R/fm300/1000 still fail.
pcb_action: 反馈电容必须可换：U4A 2.2/4.7/10/22/47/100p，U4B 4.7/10/22/47/100/220p；预留 Rlead-Clead 串联 lead-lag DNP 支路。

test: pure-vendor AD633 fit + full-chain servo injection
status: PASS for injection; static trim alone insufficient
evidence: AD633 fitted: c0=4.989mV, cx=0.500mV/V, cy=0.500mV/V, cxy=0.09997V/V². ZSERVO injection tested in full-chain.
pcb_action: AD633 Z pin 必须预留至少两个注入位：静态 trim 和 ZSERVO；最好再预留 VK feedthrough compensation 输入。
caveat: 不要只靠常数 trim 覆盖 1–100Ω；需要随 Rtarget/VK 调度或 DC servo。

evidence: dynamic low-slice A6: ok=3/4. Zobel 10Ω+100nF and strong 5Ω+220nF both converged with ilim≈0.0065, xmax≈0.0022; Riso-only case failed at OPA548 zener initial point.
pcb_action: 预留 Riso，但不要只装 Riso：建议 Riso 0.05–0.2Ω + DNP/可装 Zobel 10Ω+100nF 起步；保留 0Ω 旁路。
caveat: Zobel不修主 tracking，只改善功放负载稳定/收敛；最终值需实板振铃测试。

status: PASS for enable; reset-holdoff increases startup bias
evidence: B2_servo_enabled_start_r1_acoustic: dcI=4.42mA, ilim=0.0039, xmax=0.0083; B2_servo_reset_late_r1_acoustic: dcI=10.95mA, ilim=0.0095, xmax=0.0165

evidence: RMIN clamp prevents entering deepest negative-impedance region; r1 is highest-risk case, 3/5/7.2Ω should be selectable for first bring-up.
pcb_action: PCB/固件预留 Rtarget_min clamp，第一版 bring-up 从 7.2Ω→5Ω→3Ω→1Ω 逐步放开。
caveat: 需要真实 full-chain long transient 复跑最终保护阈值。

test: netlist clamp insertion + acoustic stress concept
source: AB test harness generated clamp variants
evidence: VCMD clamp can limit power-stage command, but will distort synthetic impedance when active. It is a protection, not a normal operating element.
pcb_action: 预留 VCMD limiter 或 OPA548 input clamp，推荐可调阈值 ±2V/±5V/旁路 DNP；fault 时启用，正常 tracking 不应频繁触发。
caveat: 若阈值过低，会直接破坏 1Ω tracking。

test: soft-start already used in all successful full-chain dynamic cases
status: PASS for soft-start; hardware enable not modeled
evidence: All successful full-chain pure-vendor dynamic slices used command/acoustic soft ramp; no-soft-start was not retained as acceptable bring-up path.
pcb_action: 必须预留 OPA548 enable/mute 或前级 analog switch；上电流程：mute→trim→servo enable→OPA enable→Rtarget ramp。
caveat: 当前 wrapper 没有真实 OPA548 enable pin 行为；硬件需按 datasheet 实现。

evidence: OPA1656 input-referred offset≈0.496mV; r1 trim reduced DC Iport from 41.99mA to 16.84mA before servo, then 3.64mA with servo.
pcb_action: DAC trim range至少 ±1mV input-referred，分辨率建议 <20µV；注入电阻 100k–1M，DNP 可改。
caveat: DAC噪声会进入 current-sense，需要 RC 限带和模拟地布线。

evidence: SPICE cannot verify physical probe access; without test points, root-cause isolation will be slow.
